desc: Prove the reduction: one final `nums` value covering a subset of targets must be divisible by that subset’s LCM.
Implement target deduplication, bit positions, and subset LCM precomputation.
Compute each number’s increment cost to the next multiple of every subset LCM.
Maintain copied-state bitmask DP transitions so each nums element is selected at most once.
Validate the implementation against all provided examples and complexity constraints.
